block1.title: How do we do that
block1.text: Just send a voice message to WorksRecorded WhatsApp describing what happened today. Our AI will transform your words into a structured site diary record.

block2.title: What is your benefit
block2.p1: Everything that happens on site during the project is stored and easily accessible.
block2.p4: Estimation? You know exactly how much time you’ve spent.

block1.title: How do we do that
block1.text: Workers use WhatsApp to chat with WorksRecorded to clock in and out of work. Before clocking out, the AI asks them to describe what was achieved during the day. The information is structured and stored in the database automatically.

block2.title: What is your benefit
block2.li1: Get every work hour accounted for.
block2.li2: Bid labor precisely on the next project.
block2.li3: Identify waste, set targets, and measure KPIs for labor.

block1.title: How do we do that
block1.text: We combine data science with AI and construction industry expertise to automatically extract analytics from your data. We’ll provide the insights you need—bill of quantities, progress statistics, hindrances, delays, average performance, cost per category and period, areas of waste and improvement, and more.

block2.title: What is your benefit
block2.li1: Advanced pre-made analytics for immediate results.
block2.li3: Fully dynamic — updates as the project progresses.
block2.li4: Forecast finances, cash flow, and work progress.

block1.title: How do we do that

p1.suffix: . We dive into your processes, map where value is created, and identify what data to capture and how you’ll benefit from it.

block1.p2: Once a custom system is designed and implemented, it keeps paying off—clean records, less manual work, and analytics that support decisions.
block1.p3: Email us the process you want to digitalize and automate, and we’ll propose an effective, pragmatic solution.

block2.title: What is your benefit
block2.p1: Construction is one of the last under-digitalized frontiers. Get ahead and leverage the AI wave to improve margins, bids, and day-to-day processes.
block2.p2: From construction professionals to construction professionals. Practical tools, minimal friction, real outcomes.

Pricing.description: Transparent monthly pricing per user, designed to scale with your project’s size and complexity. We also offer per-project pricing options, depending on how your company operates and discounts if you have many operatives. Contact us for a custom quote.

About.title: About
About.p1: Do you know what is happening on your construction site? Tracking construction works is not easy.
About.p2: Site management is often overloaded and reluctant to take up additional admin burden to keep records.
About.p3: Even if they exist, records are often scattered, unorganized, and need large effort to be sorted to become useful.
About.p4: When records are missing, it is hard to improve processes, track metrics, argue claims/additional works, account for lost time, or generally understand why things are where they are.
About.p5: Current digital tools are complex, take time and effort to integrate, and are often met with resistance from overloaded site teams.

p6.prefix: To help, I created a small tool called

About.p7: Site managers use WhatsApp to take voice/text notes of site activities. The system then automatically sorts and stores records, which can be viewed from a browser.
About.p8: This allows site management to spend more time on site, overseeing works, and less time in the office doing admin.
About.p9: Simultaneously, this also lets project management better understand the project so they can analyze, act, and argue their position confidently to the GC/Client.
About.p10: I have used this tool myself and find it simple yet powerful during complicated construction projects.
About.p11: I will be happy if it helps you too. It is free for one project for everyone while in beta, and I will be happy to discuss and help if you have any questions.
